unit.why: A short anecdote: R. Moshe, as a youth trading among gentiles, feels a wondrous illumination at Minha, fears it is a delusion of kelipat nogah, and asks his brother and teacher R. Zvi, who explains it as the raising of sparks.

stories.start_quote: מעט המעט מהידוע לי אספרה לאחיו
stories.end_quote: [היכל הברכה ריש פ' תבא] משמו הקדוש
stories.summary_en: While trading with gentiles in a village, R. Moshe felt all his limbs illuminated when he later prayed Minha; afraid this was an error from kelipat nogah, he asked his brother and master R. Zvi, who explained that the holy sparks in all creation cleave to him and are purified, drawing new light into his prayer.
